verdictRationale: Costco is a textbook 'simple and predictable' business operating a warehouse membership club model that has compounded revenue and earnings at 8-13% annually for decades.
summary: Costco Wholesale operates 924 warehouse club locations globally, generating $275B in annual revenue. Its profit engine is membership fees (~$5.3B in FY2025), not merchandise markup.
narrative: Costco is a textbook 'simple and predictable' business operating a warehouse membership club model that has compounded revenue and earnings at 8-13% annually for decades. Costco Wholesale operates 924 warehouse club locations globally, generating $275B in annual revenue. Its profit engine is membership fees (~$5.3B in FY2025), not merchandise markup. The membership model creates a captive, loyal customer base with 92.96% renewal rates and 141 million cardholders globally. Founded in 1983 and headquartered in Issaquah, WA, Costco employs 341,000 people and trades on NASDAQ with a market cap of $432B.
redFlags: Revenue growth reliant on warehouse expansion — organic same-store growth alone is ~5-6%
Membership model concentration risk — business model fully dependent on renewal rates staying above 90%
International expansion introduces currency and regulatory risk (non-US now 28% of warehouses)
E-commerce penetration remains low vs peers — digital transformation lag
